cited_passage: IRC § 199A, 26 U.S.C. § 199A — qualified business income deduction; 20% of QBI for pass-through entities; exclusions from QBI (capital gains, dividends, guaranteed payments, shareholder compensation); W-2 wage and UBIA limitation; SSTB definition and phaseout; available to individuals, trusts, and estates; not available to C-corporations. See law.cornell.edu/uscode/text/26/199A.
